description_en: Retrieves an overview of incremental changes in a data source
kebab_example: aliyun lhm get-meta-compare-increment-db-overview --catalog-name fluss_e2e_dlf_catalog --db-name ods_eaps --is-summary true --task-id 10001 --api-version 2025-01-16 --region cn-hangzhou
name: GetMetaCompareIncrementDbOverview

parameters.help_en: The name of the catalog. In a multi-catalog environment, it is used to locate the catalog where the destination database resides
parameters.help_zh: Catalog 名称，多 Catalog 环境下用于定位目标数据库所在的 Catalog
parameters.name: catalog_name

parameters.help_en: The name of the database for which you want to query incremental changes
parameters.help_zh: 要查询增量变化的数据库名称
parameters.name: db_name

parameters.help_en: Specifies whether to return only summary statistics
parameters.help_zh: 是否仅返回汇总统计数据
parameters.name: is_summary

parameters.help_en: The ID of the metadata comparison task, which is obtained from the return value of the create or save comparison task API operation
parameters.help_zh: 元数据比对任务 ID，取自创建或保存比对任务的返回值
parameters.name: task_id

schema.description_en: The database-level overview data of incremental changes returned by the API operation
schema.description_zh: 接口返回的库级增量变化总览数据

data.description_en: The list of data returned by the API operation. For the element structure, see the descriptions of the child fields
data.description_zh: 接口返回的数据列表，元素结构参见下级子字段说明

compareJobId.description_en: The unique identifier of the current metadata comparison job
compareJobId.description_zh: 本次元数据比对作业的唯一标识

curVersionTime.description_en: The metadata version time corresponding to the current comparison
curVersionTime.description_zh: 本次比对对应的元数据版本时间

diffAddPartitionNum.description_en: The number of partitions added compared to the last comparison
diffAddPartitionNum.description_zh: 相比上次比对新增的分区数量

diffAddTableNum.description_en: The number of tables added compared to the last comparison
diffAddTableNum.description_zh: 相比上次比对新增的表数量

diffDelPartitionNum.description_en: The number of partitions deleted compared to the last comparison
diffDelPartitionNum.description_zh: 相比上次比对删除的分区数量

diffDelTableNum.description_en: The number of tables deleted compared to the last comparison
diffDelTableNum.description_zh: 相比上次比对删除的表数量

diffModifyPartitionNum.description_en: The number of partitions whose properties changed compared to the last comparison
diffModifyPartitionNum.description_zh: 相比上次比对发生属性变更的分区数量

diffModifyTableNum.description_en: The number of tables whose structure underwent schema evolution compared to the last comparison
diffModifyTableNum.description_zh: 相比上次比对发生结构变更的表数量

diffPartitionNum.description_en: The total number of differences at the partition level, which is the sum of the number of added, deleted, and modified partitions
diffPartitionNum.description_zh: 分区维度的差异总数，等于新增、删除和修改分区数之和

diffTableNum.description_en: The total number of differences at the table level, which is the sum of the number of added, deleted, and modified tables
diffTableNum.description_zh: 表维度的差异总数，等于新增、删除和修改表数之和

prevVersionTime.description_en: The metadata version time corresponding to the last comparison
prevVersionTime.description_zh: 上次比对对应的元数据版本时间

success.description_en:
Indicates whether the call was successful. Valid values:
true: The call was successful.
false: The call failed. If the call fails, troubleshoot the issue based on errCode and errMessage
success.description_zh: 调用是否成功：true 表示成功，false 表示失败，失败时结合 errCode 与 errMessage 排查
